Landed as Gerrit change 3115 (commit 95a8346b8d3; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved, no advisories). make verify before the push: 17 failed, 19745 passed, 107 skipped; all 17 failures are the known pandoc set under tests/unit/reconciler, 0 elsewhere, 0 ERROR lines.

Change: sshsig._VERSION_RE is now OpenSSH_(?:for_Windows_)?(\d+)\.(\d+), so ssh_keygen_version() parses Microsoft's OpenSSH_for_Windows_<ver> banner. New tests/unit/test_attest_sshsig_version_banner.py (10 cases, mocked ssh -V, no ssh needed). Only those two files changed for this ticket.

Evidence. Shim = an executable named ssh first on PATH whose banner is OpenSSH_for_Windows_9.5p1, LibreSSL 3.8.2. Five modules = tests/unit/test_opcert_local_verify_binding.py, test_attestation_invalidation.py, test_opcert_binding_thread_propagation_ff4a.py, test_opcert_producer_seam_8d8e.py, tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py.
1. Banner tests, before the fix: 5 failed, 5 passed (the two Windows banners, the Windows banner on stdout, and both ensure_available cases).
2. Five modules under the shim, BEFORE the fix: 50 failed, 47 passed (2026-10-25 21:58 PDT). AFTER the fix: 97 passed (22:02 PDT). Real ssh (OpenSSH 10.3) after: 97 passed.
3. Merged main (HEAD 6080140e7af), 2026-10-25 23:43 PDT: banner module plus test_attest_sshsig.py and test_attest_sshsig_heldout.py -> 24 passed; five modules under the shim -> 102 passed; real ssh -> 102 passed. The 5 extra tests are the helper tests added by d23c to the isolation module.
4. git diff --stat 1c03961ec1f HEAD lists src/rebar/attest/sshsig.py (this ticket), tests/unit/test_attest_sshsig_version_banner.py (this ticket) and tests/interfaces/test_rebar_repo_isolation.py (d23c).

Unverified: the banner the Windows runner's ssh -V really prints, and whether the windows-2025-vs2026 image has OpenSSH at all (the plain windows-2025 readme lists none; the 2026-09-21 job log has no ssh -V output). If the runner has none, this change does nothing there and d23c's skip is the effective guard. The effect on the Windows sweep will show on its next run.
